points.name: Aurora Main Stage
points.description: The main stage for headliners, from 20:00 until 02:00. Accessible viewing platform on the right side.

points.name: The Hollow Tent
points.description: Circus tent for electronic sets and late-night shows. Gets busy after midnight.

points.name: Night Market Food Court
points.description: Food trucks around shared picnic tables, with vegan and gluten-free options.

points.name: Ember Pizza Wagon
points.description: Wood-fired pizza by the slice until 03:00.

points.name: Main Bar
points.description: Beer, cocktails and free water refills. Bring your reusable cup.

points.name: Lakeside Bar
points.description: A quieter bar on a deck by the pond, with low-alcohol and alcohol-free drinks.

points.name: Toilets North
points.description: Portable toilets with one accessible cabin, close to the main stage field.

points.name: Toilets East
points.description: Larger toilet block with handwashing stations, near the food court.

points.name: Medical Tent
points.description: Paramedics on site around the clock. Free earplugs, sunscreen and water too.

points.name: Info Point
points.description: Lost and found, phone charging and help with your wristband.

points.name: Main Gate
points.description: Main entrance and exit with bag checks. Shuttle buses stop just outside.

points.name: Camping Gate
points.description: Gate to the campsite. You need a wristband with camping access.

points.name: Merch Tent
points.description: Official T-shirts, posters and tote bags. Card payment only.
